# Project 4: how the After-Booking app was built

Project in BAS: /home/user/projects/TravelOrder-AfterBooking
Requirements: project-4-fiori-btp/requirements.md. The business rules were decided by the students (Nidhi and Aathrav).

## Step 8: built with Claude Code (not generated by Project Accelerator)
- db/schema.cds: Bookings, BookingHistory, BookingStatus.
- srv/booking-rules.js: refund percentage, refund amount, EUR 50 change fee, manager limit, date rules.
- srv/service.cds and srv/service.js: changeDates, cancelBooking, approveRefund, status rules, history record for each action.
- app/afterbooking/annotations.cds: list, filters, details page, buttons.
- The Fiori app skeleton (webapp, ui5.yaml, package.json) was copied from the Project 2 app, which Project Accelerator generated, and renamed.

## Decisions made while building
- After cancelling: refund 0 goes to Cancelled; refund up to EUR 1,000 goes to Refunded; refund above EUR 1,000 goes to Cancellation Requested until a manager approves it, then Refunded.
- Cancel Booking asks for confirmation.
- Bookings are read-only except through the three actions.

## Tests
- 19 of 19 passed: 8 calculation checks (30, 29, 14 and 13 days; EUR 1,000 and EUR 1,001) and 11 service checks.
- First run showed 5 FAIL lines caused by the test comparing the text 1350.00 to the number 1350; the test was corrected, the app was not changed.
- In the app: list and filters shown; Cancel Booking on AB-1001 gave 90%, EUR 1,350, Manager Approval Needed, history entry; confirmation dialog appears.

## Not done yet
- Manager role is not enforced yet; any user can press Approve Refund. Planned for deployment step.
- Runs in BAS test mode with temporary data, not yet on BTP.
- Sample dates are fixed (for example AB-1003 and AB-1004 in November 2026); refresh them before the exam so the 50% and 0% cases still work.

## Step 9: backend connection confirmed
- Connection type: SAP Fiori elements app to its own CAP OData V4 service.
- UI configuration: manifest.json data source /odata/v4/after-booking/ (OData 4.0).
- Service offers: Bookings, History, BookingStatus; actions changeDates, cancelBooking, approveRefund.
- Live read from the service returned booking AB-1002.
- Server log shows POST /odata/v4/after-booking/$batch requests from the screen.
- No code changed in this step. No external API or S/4HANA connection is used in Project 4.

## Step 10: deployment to SAP BTP (in progress)
- Target: Cloud Foundry, org e2029c81trial, space dev. Free plans only.
- HANA Cloud instance travelorder-hana (plan hana-free) created. Admin password generated randomly and kept only in a private file in BAS.
- cds add hana, xsuaa, approuter, html5-repo, mta generated the deployment setup.
- Manager role added: approveRefund requires Manager; the whole service requires login. Role collection: TravelOrder_Manager.
- Tests: 22 of 22 passed, including agent refused (403), manager allowed, no login refused (401).

Deployment problems and fixes:
- First deploy: home address showed "Cannot GET /" because the generated router sent all addresses to the backend. Router routes changed so the screens come from the HTML5 repository.
- The copied app settings had no sap.cloud section, so it was added and the app uploaded to the HTML5 repository.
- Then 503: router log said "Service Tag travelorderafterbooking is unknown". That address format is for the managed router; this standalone router uses /afterbooking/index.html.
- Result: live app on BTP opened and loaded 8 bookings from SAP HANA Cloud.
- Live URL: https://e2029c81trial-dev-travelorder-afterbooking.cfapps.us10-001.hana.ondemand.com/
- TravelOrder_Manager assigned to the student's user in the BTP cockpit.
- Live test after a fresh login: Approve Refund on AB-1007 (EUR 1,800) changed the status to Refunded and wrote a history entry with the user's email, stored in SAP HANA Cloud.
- The home address now forwards to /afterbooking/index.html.
- Not yet tested on the live app at that point: a user without the Manager role being refused (tested locally only). Tested live in Step 11, see below.

## Step 11: full test on the live app (9 Nov 2026)
Run on the deployed app with SAP HANA Cloud, through the Fiori screens unless noted. Screenshots 15 to 24.

| # | Test | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | List loads | 8 bookings | Pass |
| 2 | Filter destination Rome | AB-1005 only | Pass |
| 3 | Change Dates, return before departure | Refused, no fee | Pass |
| 4 | Change Dates, departure in the past | Refused, no fee | Pass |
| 5 | Change Dates, valid (AB-1005) | New dates, fees 50 to 100, status Changed, history | Pass |
| 6 | Cancel asks for confirmation | Dialog | Pass |
| 7 | Cancel over limit (AB-1005, 90% of 3,200) | 2,880, Cancellation Requested, Approve Refund enabled | Pass |
| 8 | Approve Refund | Refunded, history, all buttons disabled | Pass |
| 9 | Cancel 30+ days (AB-1002, 90% of 800) | 720, Refunded, no manager | Pass |
| 10 | Cancel 14 to 29 days (AB-1003, 19 days, 50% of 1,200) | 600, Refunded | Pass |
| 11 | Cancel under 14 days (AB-1004, 5 days) | 0, Cancelled | Pass |
| 12 | Direct server request: change or cancel a Refunded booking; change or approve a Cancelled booking | Refused (409) | Pass |
| 13 | Direct server request: Approve Refund from a session without the Manager role | Refused (403) | Pass |

Test 13 control: the same session and token got 409 on Change Dates, so the 403 came from the role check and not the security token. It was run on a Cancelled booking, so nothing could change.

Problems found (not fixed yet):
- History rows are not sorted by time (AB-1005 showed 16:16:39, 16:16:43, 16:16:17).
- After Approve Refund the screen still shows Manager Approval Needed: Yes until the page is reloaded. The stored value is correct (false).
- The confirmation text is the generic "Perform this action?" and does not show the refund amount.

Not tested live: the exact boundaries (30, 29, 14, 13 days; EUR 1,000 and 1,001) and the status and departure date filters. The boundaries passed in the local tests.

Sample data after the test: only AB-1001 is still Confirmed. AB-1002, 1003, 1004 and 1005 were changed by this test.

## Step 11: fixes after the live test (9 Nov 2026)
- History now sorted newest first (UI.PresentationVariant). Confirmed live on AB-1005.
- Approve Refund now refreshes Manager Approval Needed (side effect added). Annotation confirmed in the live metadata; not clicked live, because only AB-1001 is left to approve.
- New calculated field Refund if Cancelled Today (not stored in the database). AB-1001 shows 1,350.00 live.
- Confirmation text changed through enhanceI18n, since the framework dialog cannot show a per-booking amount. Confirmed live; closed without confirming.
- Mistake found by the live check: the first version calculated the field only when price, date and status arrived in one request, so the screen showed an empty value. Corrected to read those values from the database and redeployed.
- Local tests after the fixes: 22 of 22 passed. The deploy script removes node_modules, so npm ci is needed before local tests.

## Manual test by the student in her own browser (9 Nov 2026)
- AB-1001: Change Dates to 20 to 30 Jul 2027, fee 50 EUR, status Changed, history entry. Cancel Booking: 90% = 1,350 EUR, Cancellation Requested. Approve Refund: Refunded, Manager Approval Needed No without reload, history newest first with the student's name. PASS.
- Found: the short app address (ending in .com/) ended on the SAP login page "Where to?" in the student's browser, also in incognito. The full address ending in /afterbooking/index.html works. Workaround: bookmarks with the full addresses. Same applies to Projects 2 and 3.
